notes: Read SKILL.md in full (the only file). Zero-downtime deployment strategies: blue-green with Kubernetes Service selector switching and AWS CodeDeploy appspec, canary with Istio and Argo Rollouts plus a Prometheus AnalysisTemplate, rolling updates, a Flask health/readiness endpoint, and rollback scripts and checklist.

Medium because the skill's scripts change live cluster state: `kubectl patch svc` to switch traffic (SKILL.md:175), `kubectl set image` / `rollout undo` (357-372), and an auto-rollback loop that runs `kubectl rollout undo` when a Prometheus success rate drops (425-449). Acceptable: deploying and rolling back is exactly what the user asks this skill for, the switch script first checks rollout status and health, nothing deletes resources or disables security controls, and the rollback checklist (453-470) includes confirming and notifying the team.

Users should review the scripts before running them against production: the switch script uses `kubectl exec -it` (not suitable for non-interactive CI) and the readiness endpoint returns raw exception strings (SKILL.md:405-416), which can leak connection details. Related Skills links `../../orchestration/kubernetes-ops/`, `../../orchestration/argocd-gitops/`, `../feature-flags/` (SKILL.md:499-501) are optional sibling skills that do not ship with this one.
